initialExam.title: IBPS Clerk 2026
initialExam.description: IBPS Clerical Cadre exam for recruitment as clerks in public sector banks across India.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Numerical Ability (35Q), Reasoning (35Q). Mains: Reasoning/Computer (50Q), English (40Q), Quant (50Q), GK (50Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 190 questions, 200 marks, 160 minutes.
initialExam.jobRole: Clerk/Junior Associate in public sector banks
initialExam.careerGrowth: Clerk → Officer (through JAIIB/CAIIB) → Branch Manager → higher posts.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibps.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Basic Pay (12th Bipartite Settlement) + DA + HRA

initialExam.perks: Medical insurance, LFC, Loans at concessional rates
